blockerRemoved: Fresh development tasks now have an executable schema that cannot carry known exposed task identities, revisions, fix fields, outcome fields or training traces.

guidanceChange.prior: Freeze fresh samples before comparison and do not relabel exposed fixes, enforced only by prose and exposed-workload schemas.
guidanceChange.proposed: Require the fresh-task admission validator and its exclusion registry before any task is labelled fresh.
guidanceChange.expectedBenefit: Reduce accidental fix/outcome contamination and task relabelling before matched-control trials.
guidanceChange.rollbackCondition: Admit no task if its source, selection query, evaluator boundary or lack of fix/outcome exposure cannot be verified without inspecting solution bytes.
guidanceChange.cadenceRationale: Useful bounded local work remains ready and no writer contention was observed.

largestRemainingUncertainty: Whether inherited training-only failure-analysis state improves descendant successor productivity on genuinely fresh tasks at equal total cost.
nextAcceptance: Freeze at least one independently reviewed pre-outcome public development task and parent-only evaluator capsule through this validator without acquiring fix or outcome bytes; then obtain compatible isolated-runner evidence and explicit repair-resource approval before any trial.
